name: llmster
desc: Headless daemon that serves models from a machine with no screen.
desc_zh: 在没有屏幕的机器上提供模型服务的无界面守护进程。
solves: The desktop app assumed someone was sitting at the machine; llmster runs the same core on a server and is reached over the network.
solves_zh: 桌面应用默认有人坐在机器前；llmster 把同一个核心放到服务器上跑，通过网络访问。
best_for: You want one GPU box in a cupboard serving models to the whole team.
best_for_zh: 想拿一台塞在柜子里的 GPU 机器给全团队提供模型服务。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — lmstudio.ai/blog）。 Ships inside the LM Studio 0.4.0 release but has its own installer, versioning and docs. Headless daemon for machines with no screen. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.lmstudio.ai/blog/0.4.0
